{% set blend_items = [] %}
{% set blend_ids = [] %}
{% for i in range(1, 11) %}
{% if _context.get('blend_' ~ i|string ~ '_id') %}
{% set _ = blend_items.append(i) %}
{% set _ = blend_ids.append(_context['blend_' ~ i|string ~ '_id']) %}
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
-- Returns the {{horizon}} most recent months where ALL models have complete data (no NULLs)
-- Joins MonthlyPerformance with Model table to translate APLPerformanceID -> APLID
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT TOP {{horizon}}
        MonthID
        {% for blend_id in blend_ids %}
        , [{{ blend_id }}]
        {% endfor %}
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            mp.MonthID,
            m.APLID AS ItemID,
            mp.Performance
        FROM AM.dbo.MonthlyPerformance mp
        INNER JOIN Platform.dbo.Model m ON mp.ItemID = m.APLPerformanceID
        WHERE m.APLID IN ({% for blend_id in blend_ids %}'{{ blend_id }}'{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %})
    ) AS src
    PIVOT (
        MAX(Performance)
        FOR ItemID IN ({% for blend_id in blend_ids %}[{{ blend_id }}]{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %})
    ) AS p
    WHERE {% for blend_id in blend_ids %}[{{ blend_id }}] IS NOT NULL{% if not loop.last %}
      AND {% endif %}{% endfor %}
    ORDER BY MonthID DESC
) AS RecentMonths
ORDER BY MonthID ASC
